rows.label: bf04090100_0010
rows.name: Right, so we're setting sail tomorrow.

rows.label: bf04090100_0020
rows.name:
Everyone, make sure
you're ready by then!

rows.label: bf04090100_0060
rows.name:
They gather rare things here from all over the world.
Do you like it?

rows.label: bf04090100_0070
rows.name:
Yes. If there's time before we leave,
I think I'll have another cup later.

rows.label: bf04090100_0080
rows.name:
Yeah, after a voyage, it's nice
being able to sleep at an inn.

rows.label: bf04090100_0090
rows.name:
I can get some good rest at
an inn I'm used to, too.
